extracted.intended_audience: professional female photojournalists interested in applying for the Canon Women Photojournalist Grant at Visa pour l'Image
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for applying to the Canon Women Photojournalist Grant (Visa pour l'Image), including eligibility, selection criteria, timelines, and award conditions for an 8,000-euro grant to support a photojournalism project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — professional female photojournalists
rubrics_metrics.description: It is open to professional female photojournalists, with no restrictions on age or nationality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must identify as female and be professional photojournalists; there are explicitly no age or nationality limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose — support creation of a photojournalism project
rubrics_metrics.description: It is intended to support a female photographer in the creation of a photojournalism project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The grant is specifically for the production/development of a photojournalism project (i.e., funds are to be used to create a project rather than for unrelated purposes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion — photographic quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Photographic merit/visual quality of work is a primary factor in jury evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion — journalistic approach
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The jury assesses the journalistic rigor, method, storytelling, and ethics of the proposed/produced work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion — relevance of the chosen subject
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection criteria include ... the relevance of the chosen subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject choice should be timely, important, or otherwise compelling from a journalistic perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant amount and funding source
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant, awarded annually in Perpignan during the Visa pour l’Image – Perpignan International Photojournalism Festival, is funded by Canon with a grant of 8,000 euros.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award value is €8,000 and is provided by Canon; applicants should plan projects consistent with the scale of this funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project completion timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: The supported project must be completed within one year so that it can be presented at the 2027 edition of the festival.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recipients are expected to finish the project within twelve months of award to enable presentation at the next festival edition (2027).

rubrics_metrics.name: Awarding and presentation timing
rubrics_metrics.description: The grant will be awarded in September 2026 during one of the screening evenings at the Visa pour l’Image – Perpignan festival.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award ceremony occurs at the festival in September; recipients should be available to present/participate at that event.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process timing and jury
rubrics_metrics.description: The winner will be selected in June by a jury composed of professionals from the fields of photography and journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is by a professional jury (photography and journalism backgrounds) in June; applicants should expect professional peer evaluation rather than public voting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted by this date to be considered; late submissions are not mentioned and likely not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application procedure and rules access
rubrics_metrics.description: Log in or create an account to apply for awards, submit your work, and view exclusive information. Rules for the Canon Women Photojournalist Grant (French version) or Canon Women Photojournalists Grant Rules (English version).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must register on the Visa pour l'Image site to apply; official, language-specific rules and the application form are available (French and English) and should be consulted for detailed requirements.
